title: First paid jobs and summers with the brass band
summary: Winstead and the brass band paid him the same as everyone; summers were fairs, with marches, overtures and popular tunes.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you remember your first job that you played where you got paid? Or even if you didn't get paid, if it was for some sort of a dance or entertainment or what it was for?

Well, now I can't remember the first job. But I think my first job was with this fellow I was telling you about. Winstead and he paid. I got paid. I can't remember what it was. But... And that's one thing about those fellows. That's where they all... Anytime I would work with this fellow Winstead or... Yeah. Or this other fellow that had the band, the brass band. Why... They'd get... And he paid me the same amount of money that they paid everybody. Always. And so I always had... Little jobs, you know. After they'd take me in the band and every time they'd get a job they'd take... They'd include me. So... If I had a little job during the winter months, why... As soon as summer comes, they'd begin to get... They'd get quite a bit of work in the summer. Yeah. Why then I'd let the job alone and if I couldn't work it in with that and go on with the band. And I... Every summer, I was with the brass band and they played a lot of fairs and that sort of thing. Mostly marches then.
That's right. But not anything that would be like the jazz... Well, no.

They played a lot of popular... They played a lot of popular numbers, yes. They did, too? But they played a little of everything. I see, yeah. They had some pretty good fellas, pretty good musicians on there. They had... They played these light overtures and those little nice... uh... Uh... Numbers, you know. And marches. And then, uh... They played the popular... I think. Popular tunes. It was... It was... Everything. They played a little everything. But, uh... The fellas... We had fellas in there that played in augustry and they'd get out and, uh... Uh... Uh... We had, uh... We had, uh... Those guys would entertain just like...

Like an orchestra. The brass band. The brass band. Because there was two groups in there that... That had orchestras, worked orchestras, and they were in that brass band, you know. Yeah, I see. And it wasn't hard for them to... Get together though.
